title: Aerated Resinous Kenyan Tripe Bisque
description: A post-workout Kenyan dish featuring tripe, deglazed fond, and a halal-friendly twist. This bisque is rich in protein and low in calories, making it an excellent choice for athletes.

ingredients.name: Tripe
ingredients.notes: Fresh or frozen tripe, washed and cleaned

instructions: Cook the tripe in a large pot of boiling salted water for 10 minutes.
Drain the tripe and set it aside to cool.
In the same pot, heat the coconut oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it's translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the sliced ginger and minced garlic and cook for another minute.
Deglaze the pot with the reduced beef stock, scraping the bottom to release any browned bits.
Add the cooled tripe to the pot and stir to coat with the deglazed fond.
Pour in the full-fat coconut milk and stir to combine.
Season the bisque with unrefined sea salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste.
If desired, aerate the bisque by stirring in a small amount of club soda or seltzer water.
Serve the bisque hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
